modalLead: The latest nextdash.cc posts on the config overview, shorter news dates, and two fixes to the Health row menu.

items.text: The overview shows the latest news. The two newest posts from nextdash.cc sit above the tiles, one line each.
News dates say which day. Day and month in your own date format rather than a weekday that every row shared.
A row's menu opens next to the row and draws above the header rather than underneath it.
